def solve(case):
    nodes = case["nodes"]
    required = set(case["required_symbols"])
    node_map = {n["id"]: n for n in nodes}
    children = {n["id"]: [] for n in nodes}
    for n in nodes:
        p = n["parent"]
        if p is not None:
            children[p].append(n["id"])
    remaining = set(node_map.keys())
    # order
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n["depth"], n["id"]))
    removed_order = []
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        nid = node["id"]
        if nid not in remaining:
            continue
        if not node["removable"]:
            continue
        # collect subtree in remaining
        subtree = set()
        stack = [nid]
        while stack:
            cur = stack.pop()
            if cur in remaining:
                subtree.add(cur)
                for child in children.get(cur, []):
                    if child in remaining:
                        stack.append(child)
        # check all removable
        all_removable = all(node_map[desc]["removable"] for desc in subtree)
        if not all_removable:
            continue
        # compute symbols after removal
        # gather symbols from all remaining except subtree
        remaining_after = remaining - subtree
        symbols_after = set()
        for rid in remaining_after:
            symbols_after.add(node_map[rid]["symbol"])
        # check required
        if required.issubset(symbols_after):
            # perform removal
            for desc in subtree:
                remaining.discard(desc)  # discard to avoid error if already removed
            removed_order.append(nid)
    retained = sorted(remaining)
    return {"removed_node_ids": removed_order, "retained_node_ids": retained}
